scope: Exact paper sizing and AutoResearch accounting/objective integrity; not the complete autonomous trading-policy transport

exact_paper_size.incompatible_cap_behavior: Reject, never shrink the requested order
exact_paper_size.risk_caution_behavior: Shadow an incompatible 0.1 SOL opportunity instead of executing a smaller order; hard safety gates remain
exact_paper_size.execution: Reject other amounts before quote or portfolio writes; require actual exact-size Jupiter quote proof even when the legacy price gate is disabled
exact_paper_size.research: Remove inert amount/size dimensions from candidate generation, disable pure lane-sizing experiments and exclude them from automatic bandit selection
exact_paper_size.contract_protection: Chosen exact-size settings cannot be changed by AutoResearch; exported paper profiles force the 0.1 SOL contract
exact_paper_size.live_behavior: No automatic change or live activation

accounting_repairs: Offline threshold hypotheses are explicitly unscored; no arbitrary threshold arithmetic is presented as expected performance
Never reinterpret percentage-point sums as USD profit
Legacy replay monetary objectives require finite net USD rather than uncosted gross PnL; gross USD and percentage-point diagnostics remain separately labelled
Current-run metrics do not borrow global historical paper returns or decision-row performance; companion health/position diagnostics require matching run identity
Current-run and historical paper reports expose net USD only when every terminal trade has validated finite estimated cash accounting
Missing hard-gate metrics reject an objective instead of producing only a warning; unknown API error sources are not imputed zero
Invalid weights, penalties, gate limits and nonfinite score arithmetic cannot accept a challenger
Estimated execution models must explicitly state observed_execution=false
